### GameSquare to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


10/05/2026


**FRISCO, TX /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 5, 2026 /** GameSquare Holdings, Inc. ("GameSquare" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:GAME), a next-generation media, entertainment, technology and digital native treasury company, today announced that the Company will participate at the 2026 Maxim Growth Summit and the 2026 ThinkEquity Conference.


**2026 Maxim Growth Summit**
**Date:** October 12th to 14th
**Location:** The Hard Rock Hotel NYC
**1x1 Meetings:** Please contact your Maxim representative


For more information and a complete agenda of the Maxim Growth Summit, please visit[www.maximgrp.com/2026-growth-summit](https://pr.report/s19o) .


**2026 ThinkEquity Conference**
**Date:** October 15th
**Location:** Mandarin Oriental Hotel NYC
**1x1 Meetings:** Please contact your ThinkEquity representative


For more information and a complete agenda of the ThinkEquity Conference, please visit[https://www.think-equity.com/thinkequity-conference](https://pr.report/s19p) .


**About GameSquare Holdings, Inc.**
GameSquare (NASDAQ: GAME) is a cutting-edge media, entertainment, and technology company transforming how brands and publishers connect with Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Millennial audiences. With a platform that spans award-winning creative services, advanced analytics, and FaZe Esports, one of the most iconic gaming organizations, we operate one of the largest gaming media networks in North America. As a digital-native business, GameSquare provides brands with unparalleled access to world-class creators and talent, delivering authentic connections across gaming, esports, and youth culture. Complementing our operating strategy, GameSquare has developed an innovative treasury management program designed to generate yield and enhance capital efficiency, reinforcing our commitment to building a dynamic, high-performing media company at the intersection of culture, technology, and next-generation financial innovation.


To learn more, visit[www.gamesquare.com](https://pr.report/s19q) .
